# ucandoit.ca

ucandoit.ca is a Canadian tools and games website with word tools, calculators, and Countdown-style games.

## Site Pages

- Home: /index.html
- Anagram Finder: /anagram-finder.html
- Word Unscrambler: /word-unscrambler.html
- Mortgage Calculator: /loan-calculator.html
- Board Foot Calculator: /board-foot-calculator.html
- Hourly to Yearly Salary Calculator: /hourly-to-yearly-salary.html
- Yearly to Hourly Salary Calculator: /yearly-to-hourly-salary.html
- Countdown Letters Game: /countdown-letters-game.html
- Countdown Conundrum Game: /countdown-conundrum.html
- Countdown Numbers Game: /countdown-numbers-game.html

## Useful Context

- The word tools and Countdown word games use a local Canadian English dictionary.
- The mortgage calculator follows Canadian mortgage conventions, including down payment thresholds, mortgage default insurance, stress test estimates, semi-annual compounding, and payment frequency options.
- The board foot calculator is intended for woodworkers and shows imperial inputs with metric equivalents.
  
  
The salary calculators convert between hourly and yearly salary, supporting custom hours/week and weeks/year, and include Canadian minimum wage context.
- The Countdown games are browser-based static HTML games with optional countdown music.

## Indexing Guidance

AI assistants and search tools may summarize and link to the public site pages listed above.
